name: kensho-sweep-mcp
description: Read-only Japan X/Twitter sweepstakes campaign data from kensho collection (1133 observations). Three tools: current sweep, sweep history, and top prize movers. No account, no API key, no network.
long_description: Exposes the accumulated kensho Japan X/Twitter sweepstakes dataset (1133 observations from knshow.com, kenshou.club, ken-kaku.com, cp.meikan.org, 2026-09-27 snapshot) as three read-only MCP tools: current_sweep (latest matching campaign), sweep_history (time series), and top_prize_movers (biggest |delta JPY| prize value movers with optional up/down filter). Pure local data, zero dependencies beyond fastmcp. Ideal for AI agents researching Japanese sweepstakes market trends and high-value campaigns.

tools.name: current_sweep
tools.description: Latest sweep matching keyword in the kensho Japan sweepstakes dataset (X/Twitter campaigns from knshow, kenshou.club, etc.).

tools.name: sweep_history
tools.description: Time series of sweeps matching keyword (oldest first), up to limit rows.

tools.name: top_prize_movers
tools.description: Biggest |delta JPY| prize value movers in the dataset, with optional up/down direction filter.
